text: This is my 3rd attempt to rectify this matter. I mailed out previous letters to the corporation and to the non affiliated credit reporting XXXX XXXX and Experian ). This is last attempt to rectify this matter before I take this to arbitration and to small claims court. According to 15 USC 6802 no financial institution should disclose any non public information to a non affiliated 3rd party. In the disclosures the company never stated that they were going to release my personal in formation to the non affiliated 3rd party nor did they say that it will negatively impact my credit score. Pursuant to 15 USC 6802 b ( 1 ) ( b ) and ( c ) they were supposed to give information on how I can opt of sharing my non public information which they did not. When I reached out to the company I spoke to a XXXX and he laughed in my ear about my concern. I also reported this to the attorney general and I got a response saying according to their policy they do not give consumers opportunities to opt-out. Well I thought federal law subsidies policy any day. I also mailed a letter to the CRA and I git a generic response. We all know the CRAs and XXXX XXXX are not affiliated in any way or are they controlled by the same owners. Unless someone is paying for my non public to furnished.
